hook: i watched 1000 hours of huberman so you don't have to
caption: These are the protocols that come up over and over. He's right that they're worth trying. He cannot tell you which ones are yours.
notes: Name-check post. Do not imply endorsement, do not use his likeness, do not invent quotes. The turn at slide 7 is the whole post; everything before it is the bait.

slides.text: Sunlight in your eyes within an hour of waking.

So adenosine clears on its own instead of getting masked.

slides.text: Zone 2, two to three hours a week.
slides.sub: Slow enough to hold a conversation. Boring on purpose.

slides.text: Ten minutes of non-sleep deep rest.
slides.sub: Lie down, eyes closed, no input. Not a nap.

slides.text: The sleep stack: magnesium, theanine, apigenin.
slides.sub: The most quoted three, and the most bought three.

slides.text: Here's the part that took me 1000 hours to notice.
Every one of these is an average.
slides.sub: It's what happened to a group of people in a study. It is not a prediction about you.

slides.text: Two of these did nothing for me.
slides.sub: I only know that because I stopped them one at a time and watched what happened.

slides.text: he can tell you what's worth trying. nobody can tell you what works on you.
